verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say it "automatically categorizes your transactions and learns from your changes." The AI categorizes about 97% of synced transactions on the first pass, leaves low-confidence ones uncategorized for manual review, and lets rules override its choices; AI categorization actions are also logged in the audit trail. Missing for 10: detail on how learning from corrections works (vs. explicit rules), confirmation that CSV/PDF-imported transactions get the same auto-categorization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
